• Customer support software helps businesses manage customer inquiries, track tickets, assign agents, and resolve problems without switching between different communication tools.
  • For US businesses, customers may contact a company through email, website chat, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, SMS, or WhatsApp. Managing these channels separately creates missed inquiries, repeated replies, and poor visibility into unresolved requests.
  • MSG91 Hello is AI customer support software for US businesses that brings these conversations into one shared inbox. It combines ticket management, AI chatbots, automation, cloud calling, and analytics.
  • With unlimited agents and no per-agent license fees, teams can expand customer service operations without paying for every additional support representative.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Hello, and how does it work?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello is an AI-powered customer support platform that combines customer conversations, ticket management, AI automation, and agent collaboration in one workspace.
  • Getting started involves five steps:
    • Connect channels: Add website chat, email, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, RCS, and other connected channels.
    • Invite agents: Add team members and configure their roles and permissions.
    • Create an AI chatbot: Use the no-code builder to set up an initial agentic AI bot in minutes.
    • Automate workflows: Route tickets to departments, agents, or AI bots.
    • Monitor performance: Review agent activity, ticket volume, and customer satisfaction.
  • For example, a US SaaS company can use AI to answer subscription inquiries while escalating technical issues to a human support representative with the customer's conversation history.

faqs.question: Which communication channels can US businesses manage through MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello brings customer interactions together across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, email, website live chat, SMS, RCS, X (Twitter), and connected calling services. Apple Messages for Business can also be considered where the integration is enabled.
  • Each customer conversation can be organized as a ticket, with customer details, previous messages, notes, and assigned agents visible in the same workspace.
  • A US online retailer, for example, can handle delivery questions through website chat, respond to Instagram inquiries, and manage support emails without maintaining separate helpdesk systems.
  • The platform also supports AI-assisted replies and ticket management through its web dashboard and mobile app.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 Hello combine rule-based workflows and agentic AI in one chatbot?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello combines structured rule-based steps with agentic AI inside a single chatbot.
  • Rule-based steps are useful for collecting account details, order numbers, or selecting predefined services. Agentic AI can then interpret the customer's request, answer follow-up questions, and use connected APIs to retrieve relevant information.
  • For example, a customer asks a US electronics retailer to track an order. The chatbot collects the order number through a fixed step, retrieves shipment information, and explains the delivery status conversationally.
  • The no-code AI chatbot builder also provides API integrations, different AI model options, fallback configurations, and human-agent handover.

faqs.question: Can multiple support agents manage one WhatsApp Business number?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello allows multiple authorized agents to manage customer-service conversations from one connected WhatsApp Business number using separate logins.
  • Managers can assign tickets to departments, transfer conversations, add internal notes, and review ticket history. Automated workflows help distribute incoming inquiries and reduce duplicate responses.
  • For example, a US healthcare provider can direct appointment questions to reception, billing inquiries to accounts, and complex patient service requests to an authorized staff member.
  • Every Hello plan includes unlimited agents, so adding support representatives does not create additional per-agent license fees.
  • Want to make it easier for customers to contact your business on WhatsApp? Use MSG91's Free WhatsApp Link Generator to create click-to-chat links, QR codes and website chat widgets with optional pre-filled messages. Once your WhatsApp Business channel is connected to MSG91 Hello, your support team can manage customer conversations from the shared inbox.

faqs.question: Can customer support agents handle calls through MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello combines customer messaging with cloud calling and IVR workflows, helping businesses manage phone-related support alongside digital conversations.
  • Depending on the configured calling service, teams can use call routing, IVR menus, call records, and mobile calling features. Agents can also initiate outbound support calls through the Hello mobile app.
  • For example, a US property management company can use IVR to direct maintenance requests, leasing questions, and billing inquiries to different teams.
  • MSG91 also offers AI voice assistance for configured experiences. Website voice-bot capabilities and telephone IVR features should be configured according to the intended use case.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Chat Window, and how does it help reduce WhatsApp support costs?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Chat Window lets a business begin a customer conversation on WhatsApp and continue the interaction in a separate web-based chat environment managed through Hello.
  • The original WhatsApp conversation remains connected to the support workflow, allowing agents to follow the customer's issue without repeatedly switching systems.
  • This is useful for lengthy troubleshooting, return requests, or technical support that requires several messages.
  • Messages exchanged inside MSG91 Chat Window do not incur Meta's WhatsApp per-message charges. Messages actually sent on WhatsApp remain subject to applicable WhatsApp pricing.
  • Learn about MSG91 Chat Window

faqs.question: How is MSG91 Hello different from Zendesk, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, and Intercom?
faqs.answer:
• The main difference is MSG91 Hello's unlimited-agent pricing model. While many competing helpdesk platforms charge per seat on paid plans, Hello lets businesses expand support teams without additional per-agent license fees.
  • MSG91 Hello also offers an omnichannel inbox, rule-based and agentic AI in one bot, API integrations, ticket automation, and configurable cloud calling.
  • Its Chat Window provides another option for continuing WhatsApp-originated customer-service conversations outside WhatsApp.
  • For US businesses comparing customer service software, Hello brings messaging, automation, customer context, and reporting together in one platform. Competitor features and charges vary by product and subscription plan.

faqs.question: Are there additional charges for agents, tickets, inboxes, or AI bots?
